_doc: The ladder the 'ladder' plugin draws (band above the prompt + /ladder pane). status: done | active | next | blocked. Claude updates this as work lands; milestones from ARCHITECTURE_SEAMS.md.
goal: Any FMB assembly hands-off on a base that is not fixed, through clean seams (vision / drive-mate / execute-mate) so prompt2assembly's planner and later an RL driver plug in

rungs.title: Loop with today's fixes
rungs.note: 3/3 plain-layout cycles (1020b)

rungs.title: Measure: ease metrics + CAD stages per part
rungs.note: insert_ease / insert_stages / INSERT_GEOMETRY.md

rungs.title: Base free + measured errors
rungs.note: PAUSED by the operator 10-20 (M3a first, on FMB1). CLEARS AT: 3 consecutive unattended FMB3 cycles (one assembly_cycle.sh run each, rc 0, base moved ~3 cm / turned ~5 deg by the arm, every part depth-confirmed; automatic recoveries allowed) + sigmas from the recorded reads. Count: 0/3 (cycles 1-5 each needed a code fix mid-run). Next qualifying runs: cycles 6-8

rungs.title: Drive-mate action + lab surface
rungs.note: FMB1 4/4 certified placed=true by ExecuteMate in one journal episode (seat errors vs the graph: -0.11 / -0.42 / -0.57 / +0.42 mm), every insert by drive-mate - but across resumed runs and one direct drive-mate insert. CLEARS AT: one uninterrupted FMB1 run with SEAMS_DRIVE=1 SEAMS_CERTIFY=1. Lessons: yellow keeps its tuned CAD seat (a CAD "fix" broke its insert); certification uses the graph's declared seats; servers re-read config per goal

rungs.title: Twin planner transfer
rungs.note: FMB1 planner on the cell, _correct_seat -> drive-mate

rungs.title: RL driver
rungs.note: admittance servo, Isaac ROS policy behind the same action

rungs.title: Cycle time measured, not guessed
rungs.note: replay + disassembly write timing rows, motion recorder (position + wrist turns), cycle_time.py. Baseline run: 1088 s wall, arm moving 25%

rungs.title: Read once, no needless trips
rungs.note: one survey window for all parts (49.0 s -> 4.7 s measured); pick check uses the known base read + parked region (was 64 s + 25 s per run); certify reads markers once; part tracker: a part seen in any view is never searched for blind

rungs.title: No process start per step
rungs.note: long-lived worker: one ROS node, primitives run in it (the 3-4.5 s per-step dead time)

rungs.title: Move floors by distance
rungs.note: 2.5 s floor for mm moves -> joint-distance durations with a lower floor; tested with nothing gripped first

rungs.title: FMB1 wall time halved, same success
rungs.note: CLEARS AT: a full FMB1 run (4/4 seated, verified) whose cycle_time.py wall time is <= 50% of the instrumented baseline, dead time <= 1 s per primitive

rungs.note: 3/3 cycles 10-18, base moved 10-20

rungs.title: FMB3 disassemble + reassemble loop
rungs.note: paused 10-20 for M3a (FMB3 fully seated). cycles 1-4 done 4/4, none clean. Cycle 4 added: program-drop recovery, CAD-fit read limits, aim by interlocked seated parts (fork_yellow first attempt). Cycle 5 = first with every fix from the start

rungs.note: view shifted so the held part clears the base

rungs.title: Seat check out of the glare
rungs.note: close, tilted 25 deg, vs the base-top plane

rungs.title: Base pose from CAD-to-depth fit
rungs.note: base_icp.py: 1.3-1.5 mm rms per view

rungs.title: Hand-eye refit from CAD fits over tilted views
rungs.note: mount already at the floor: 6-dof CAD fits agree to 1.8 mm median over 11 views; refit not needed. The 11 mm was a 4-dof fit forcing a 0.9 deg-pitched base flat

rungs.title: Base read = 6-dof CAD fit (BASE_FROM=icp)
rungs.note: startup, between parts, before insert; 1.2 mm rms live

rungs.title: Depth timing: how long after the arm stops is depth reliable
rungs.note: frames taken while moving are ~10 mm off and no time shift fixes them; after the stop they are right at once; they arrive 150 ms (p90 650 ms) late. Rule: frames stamped >= 0.25 s after the TCP stopped (no fixed sleeps); immediate reads = reads 3 s later within 0.2 mm. Left: a 1-4 mm per-view bias

rungs.title: Fused estimator INSIDE aruco_camera_localizer -> VisionPose
rungs.note: v1 in the localizer package (fused_estimator.py, af6c3a2+): base3 = 6-dof base read within 0.4 mm; loose parts refine at ~1.2 mm rms; seated parts rejected (joint multi-object fit next); per-part bias file + sigma from repeatability next; replay not consuming it yet
